extracted.name: Perfect Simple Roasted Pork Chops
extracted.description: These effortless baked pork chops are simply seasoned with salt, pepper, and thyme and then baked for a quick and tasty dinner ready in 20 minutes.
ingredient_lines: 2 tablespoons dried thyme, lightly crushed, or more to taste
salt and ground black pepper to taste
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C).
Sprinkle pork chops on all sides with thyme, salt, and pepper. Place on a baking sheet.

Bake in the preheated oven until an instant-read thermometer inserted into the thickest part of a pork chop reads 145 degrees F (63 degrees C), about 20 minutes. Tent chops with aluminum foil and let rest before serving, 5 to 10 minutes.
